title: Lab - Installing Helm
description: Install Helm and add a repository.
scenario: Install Helm and add a repository. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Install
tasks.instructions: Install the Helm CLI on the control plane node.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Repo
tasks.instructions: Add the bitnami repository and search it for wordpress.
tasks.solution:
helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
helm search repo wordpress

tasks.title: Task 3 - Hub
tasks.instructions: Search Artifact Hub for a consul chart from the CLI.
